title: Vibraphone
summary: No vibraphone is rendered. A real Iowa sustained mf C4-B4 recording has been downloaded and pinned in references-supplemental.json; the instrument still needs measured geometry and a controlled comparison.
physics_missing: A segmented, specimen-aware comparison using the acquired recording and its documented recording chain
Published aluminium-bar dimensions and undercut for one real instrument
Resonator tubes with their rotating fan valves, which give the vibrato
The tubular resonator coupling that the marimba also lacks
blocked: The reference recording is available, but the recorded instrument's bar, undercut and resonator geometry remain unidentified. The xylophone bar slice is a starting point; no vibraphone render or grading claim is made.
